title: Soft saturation guard and ephemeral circuit containment hotfix
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Hotfix: Add tenant-specific soft saturation thresholds and ephemeral circuit containment to prevent cross-region circuit leakage during transient KV/prefix pressure. Backported to release-2026-02.
description:
Motivation: We observed an incident (SUP-321) where a transient KV pressure spike in eu-west caused circuit breakers to flip aggressively and then 'leak' state across regional routing paths, causing increased tail latency and tenant SLO violations for a narrow class of traffic. This PR introduces a short-term hotfix that: (1) adds a soft saturation guard that applies adaptive per-tenant thresholds (tenant-threshold-adapter) based on recently observed request size and KV pressure; (2) implements ephemeral circuit containment to ensure circuit state changes are scoped to a region/slot and decayed aggressively to avoid cross-region contamination; (3) ships conservative defaults behind a runtime feature flag and backports the fix to release-2026-02.

Changes in this PR (high level): - runtime/eviction/tenant_thresholds.go: new adapter that computes soft thresholds per tenant using an EWMA of recent token load and KV pressure metrics. The algorithm is intentionally simple to avoid oscillations: threshold = base * (1 + alpha*short_term_pressure) with configurable alpha and a min/max clamp. - runtime/circuit/ephemeral_containment.go: isolate circuit flips to a small ephemeral namespace keyed by (region, slot, tenant_cohort). Flips are persisted in-memory with a short TTL and are not promoted to durable circuit state unless sustained for multiple windows. - api/config/flags.yaml: added feature flag controls and rollout knobs (soft_guard_enabled, containment_ttl_sec, promotion_windows). - tests/acceptance/regional_containment_test.go: integration test that recreates the observed leak pattern and validates that containment prevents cross-region propagation. - telemetry/metrics_definitions.yaml: add tenant_saturation_score and containment_promotion_count. - examples/rollouts/quickstart.md: guidance for canarying the flag per region/tenant.

Commits (summary): - 8d3f7a2: initial tenant threshold adapter and unit tests - 9b1a4c7: ephemeral circuit containment implementation - 2f4c5e8: integration test that reproduces SUP-321 scenario - 5c7bde1: feature flags and docs - 7a9bd11: fix flaky test and tune EWMA alpha for stability - squashed on merge.

Files changed (top-level overview): - runtime/eviction/tenant_thresholds.go (+210/-12) - runtime/circuit/ephemeral_containment.go (+230/-30) - tests/acceptance/regional_containment_test.go (+120/-10) - api/config/flags.yaml (+8/-0) - telemetry/metrics_definitions.yaml (+18/-0) - examples/rollouts/quickstart.md (+18/-6) - runtime/eviction/thresholds_test.go (+28/-4) - runtime/circuit/containment_test.go (+12/-6) - docs/incidents/SUP-321.md (+20/-0) - charts/values/containment-values.yaml (+62/-140)

Testing and validation: - Unit tests added for threshold math and for containment TTL logic. - An acceptance test simulates a burst of large KV-prefixed requests from eu-west while a control region receives steady low load; verifies that containment prevents flips from propagating and that promotion requires sustained pressure for promotion_windows=3. - Load-tested locally with a small cluster (4 nodes) and with mock KV pressure signals to validate EWMA behavior. - CI initially failed on a flaky timing test; adjusted sleep and retry window, CI passed on rerun. See CI: fail -> pass (rerun).

Rollout plan: - Feature flag default: disabled. - Canary in eu-west region only for tenant cohort 'A' for 30 minutes, monitor tenant_saturation_score and containment_promotion_count, watch SLO heatmap and error budget. - If stable, expand to 25% of tenants across EU regions, then global.

Telemetry and alerting changes: - New metric tenant_saturation_score exposed to the SLO dashboard. - Alert rule: containment_promotion_count > 5 in 5m for a single region triggers an on-call page to SRE for investigation (to detect possible persistent pressure rather than transient spikes).

Review conversation (high level condensed): - Marco Diaz (reviewer): "Initial reading looks good — main concern is promotion heuristic and risk of masking real upstream issues. Please add a metric and test that verifies promotion frequency when we simulate recovery." - Author (Asha): "Added containment_promotion_count metric and an acceptance test that asserts promotions are gated by promotion_windows; clarified docs on monitoring steps." - Ivy Chen: "Can we keep defaults conservative and document rollback steps? Also please add a short blurb for Dedicated customers who have pinned models." - Author: "Defaults are conservative; added quickstart + rollback docs and a note for Dedicated in examples/rollouts/quickstart.md." - Samir Kulkarni (approver): "Approve after CI green and tests are stable." - CI initially reported a timing-based test failure; author fixed flaky sleep, tests reran and passed. - Final review: Marco requested one minor rename for clarity; author applied and squashed changes.

CI and checks: - Unit tests: passed (after fix) - Integration acceptance: passed - Lint: passed - E2E (smoke): passed - Security scan: passed - Benchmark: no regression observed in local microbench for hot path.

Merge outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-03-04 after approvals and CI green. Changelog: backported to release-2026-02 and included as a hotfix. Post-merge actions: - Deployed canary to eu-west under feature flag 'containment_soft_guard' - Pager duty notified for 24h watch and SRE runbook updated (docs/incidents/SUP-321.md) - Follow-up ticket ENG-1984 created to replace EWMA with predictive model if this approach proves insufficient.
notes: This PR was created in response to a production incident and is intentionally conservative. The runtime changes are guarded by feature flags and include telemetry to monitor behavior during rollout. No durable circuit state changes were introduced by default; promotion requires sustained signals.
